count_definitions.whitespace_alphanumeric: Every whitespace-delimited item containing a letter or number, including panel numbers, variables, sequence letters and all chemical atom text-runs; pure operators excluded. RDKit split Cl and NH glyphs merged by source+atom index.
count_definitions.lexical_letters_and_numbers: Letter/number lexical tokens, compounds kept where expressed by hyphen/slash, digit groups counted; chemical atom text-runs and schematic sequence letters included. Cl/NH remain whole chemical text-runs.
count_definitions.token_cells: Seven SMILES token cells are reported as a separate visible-token category; C/O are also included in the all-visible alphanumeric count. Five punctuation-only cells are excluded from that alphanumeric count.

evidence.interpretation: Existing illustrative carbonyl fragment; wildcard atoms denote omitted substituents. No activation for this fragment was measured.
evidence.caption_material: The token strip illustrates the existing fragment *C(=O)* with the frozen ChemBERTa-77M-MTR tokenizer. Wildcards denote omitted substituents; this is not one of the three complete held-out molecules. Seven displayed tokens omit model special tokens. The carbonyl carbon is the second displayed token (zero-based index 1), aligned to the orange schematic unit cell; the strip does not depict newly measured activations.
